name: Unmarried Sex
overview: Scripture clearly defines sexual relations as intended exclusively within the covenant of marriage, where a man and woman become one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Jesus emphasizes that even lustful intent outside of marriage equates to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28), underscoring the holiness of sexual purity. The New Testament repeatedly condemns fornication and uncleanness as works of the flesh that are incompatible with the life of a believer (Galatians 5:19; Ephesians 5:3), warning that those who practice such sins forfeit their inheritance in God's kingdom (Ephesians 5:5). Thus, unmarried sex is contrary to God's design and calls for repentance and holiness among His people.
